name: Colossus - the two-tile gap refuses a body three times as wide
notes: hauler-two-tile-gap's wall and gap, unchanged - but the mover is a 3x3 colossus, not a 3x1 hauler. Same failure, confirmed at a genuinely large footprint rather than only the narrowest multi-tile case: the colossus takes one approach step, then hard-stops flush against the gap it cannot fit through, reporting move.blocked reason:terrain every tick from then on (not move.contested, not move.blocked reason:entity - the wall itself is what refuses it) until the report's stuck-streak detector raises WARN stuck. It does not pace between two tiles the way a narrower mover with more headroom can; a body this size has nowhere else to go once it is flush against the gap. specs/open-questions.md Q15 already covers this failure shape in the abstract - this fixture is the checked-in confirmation that it reproduces unchanged at three times the footprint width, not a new failure mode.
